matches.rationale: GT1 concerns the Bregman divergence definition in Section 2.3 having reversed arguments. Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 is about Section 2.1 calibration error, and pred_id 2 is about Claim C.3 in the appendix.

GT2 concerns the strong convexity definition in Section 2.4 having the wrong inequality direction (≤ instead of ≥). Neither finding addresses this defect; pred_id 1 is about calibration error normalization, and pred_id 2 is about a different inequality in Claim C.3.

GT3 concerns the calibration error definition in Section 2.1 having an erroneous 1/T factor in the weight term. Pred_id 1 directly identifies this exact defect, noting the 1/T factor is inconsistent with how calibration error is used elsewhere in the paper (e.g., Lemma 2.2 and Corollary C.5).

pred_verdicts.rationale: Detects GT3's erroneous 1/T normalization factor in the calibration error definition.
Identifies an inconsistency in Claim C.3 that is not among the ground truth defects.
